subject: Important Update: Project Deadline Extension
body: Dear Team, I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to inform you that due to unforeseen circumstances, the deadline for Project Alpha has been extended by one week. This decision was made to ensure that we deliver a high-quality output. Please adjust your timelines accordingly and reach out if you have any concerns or need further clarification. Thank you for your understanding and continued hard work. Best regards, [Your Name]
